events.title: Big Love Festival
events.description: A community-focused, immersive gathering in the Sunshine Coast hinterland featuring live music, workshops, and shared artistic expression. It emphasizes creative connection and a relaxed, bohemian atmosphere rather than a standard festival experience.

events.title: Wildflowering walk and draw at Kathleen McArthur Conservation Park
events.description: A guided outdoor session combining a nature walk through the conservation park with an informal drawing workshop. Designed for observers and creatives to document local flora in a quiet, natural setting.

events.title: Maleny Biennial Quilt Show 2026
events.description: An exhibition showcasing intricate textile and fiber art created by local makers. It offers a chance to view craftsmanship, speak with artisans, and gain appreciation for traditional manual arts.
